correctness.rationale: For each n>=5 canonical Euclidean Laplacian-column simplex, its normal cone mass is argmax probability of X=Lg with g iid N(0,1). The path Laplacian gives endpoint variance 2, bulk variance 6, correlations −2/3 at lag1 and 1/6 at lag2, all other interior pairs independent. An independent exact integer matrix calculation reconstructed those covariances for every n=5..63. The block-separation argument (block length (log n)^2 and two-index gaps) proves a Gumbel limit for the bulk maximum uniformly after bounded deletions, since adjacent joint exceedances are o(1/n). Gaussian Mills ratio at t_n(y)=sqrt6(u_n+y/u_n), u_n=Phi^{-1}(1−1/n), gives normalized endpoint density (n^3/log n)*sqrt6/u_n*phi_sqrt2(t_n(y)) ->4sqrt3*pi*e^{-3y}. Independent-index left-tail domination gives integrability. Gamma(3)=2 yields 8sqrt3*pi. Local dependent competitors X2,X3 have strictly smaller conditional regression slopes and vanish on the rare-event scale, and independent far endpoint does too; analogous bulk normal density/Gumbel integral yields sup|n omega_i−1|→0. For the star, hub argmax condition g0>(sum leaves+max leaf)/n gives limiting 1/2 and equal leaf shares. All this is asymptotic and does not claim finite-n equal angles.
